neighbours.label: precision words (precise, precisely, fine, independently) describing controlled manipulation of a physical apparatus
fire: The microscope stage can be moved precisely in steps of ten nanometres.
Each laser beam is independently adjusted to trap a single ion.
The valve allows fine adjustment of the gas flow into the chamber.
Surgeons need precise placement of the electrode inside the brain.
The motors are precisely synchronised to keep the arm steady.
Engineers tuned the magnetic field with exquisite precision.
The heaters on each wafer zone are independently regulated.
The printer head deposits cells with precise spacing on the gel.
quiet: The microscope stage can be moved by hand when the clamp is loose.
Each laser beam is reflected off a mirror onto the screen.
The valve allows the gas to flow into the chamber.
Surgeons need a clear image of the electrode inside the brain.
The motors are mounted on rubber to keep the arm quiet.
Engineers measured the magnetic field with a handheld probe.
The heaters on each wafer zone are turned on at startup.
The printer head deposits cells in rows on the gel.
